newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian offering of 4 pct in MOL ends.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian offering of 4 pct in MOL ends.

text.p: Creditanstalt Securities and Hungary's state privatisation agency APV closed a domestic offering of maximum four percent of the shares of oil and gas company MOL, Creditanstalt was quoted by the Hungarian news agency MTI as saying on Wednesday.
The domestic offering began on Monday. The lead manager Creditanstalt and APV were entitled to close it after three days in case of oversubscription.
Creditanstalt did not disclose details but said that almost 40,000 people subscribed the shares.
MOL closed at 3,420 forints on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Wednesday, down 30 forints. The subscription price at the domestic offering was 2,970 forints.
